label: manifold_on_algebraic_variety_points
title: manifold_on_algebraic_variety_points
statement: \notready Let $K$ be a field equipped with an isomorphism to the reals, complexes, or a finite extension of the $p$-adic numbers. Let $X$ be a smooth affine algebraic variety over $K$. Then the points $X(K)$ naturally inherit the structure of a manifold over $K$.
